# Interpretation

::: {.card}
### Key Findings

- Most respondents rated the credit union as either Excellent or Good.
- Employee courtesy received the strongest average score.
- Employee availability and professionalism received slightly lower scores.
- Fewer than half of respondents reported currently having a loan.
:::

::: {.card}
### Business Recommendations

- Maintain the strong employee courtesy and helpfulness performance.
- Investigate opportunities to improve employee availability.
- Promote relevant loan products to qualified members.
- Continue monitoring overall ratings and service-quality measures.
:::
